detailSections.title: Application
detailSections.content:
STZ-63 provides overload and short-circuit protection for DC distribution circuits within the ratings of the selected configuration. Review the system voltage, load current, prospective fault current and required trip curve when selecting the breaker.

For solar PV or battery projects, supply the circuit diagram and system parameters so the exact model and wiring arrangement can be checked. Pole count alone does not establish the permissible DC voltage.

detailSections.title: Specifications
detailSections.content: Review the series options below. Confirm the rated current, DC voltage, pole arrangement and breaking capacity at that voltage for the exact configuration quoted.

detailSections.title: Selection & Wiring
detailSections.content:
Select the pole configuration and B/C/D trip curve to match the circuit design. The 500V and 1000V options are configuration-dependent; do not assume that every pole option supports both voltages.

Follow the documentation for the selected model for polarity, terminal connections and any permitted series connections. Confirm the required breaking capacity against the prospective fault current at the installation point.

detailSections.title: Ordering Information
detailSections.content: For a quotation, send the STZ-63 model name, required DC voltage, rated current, poles, B/C/D trip curve, quantity and destination market. Include the wiring diagram and any documentation requirements so the configuration can be confirmed.
